map.当量浓度（N = n·z / V） 使用指南: Equivalent Concentration (N = n x z / V) User Guide
map.当量浓度 = 物质的量 × 当量数 / 体积，常用于酸碱氧化还原滴定。: Equivalent concentration = amount of substance x equivalent factor / volume, commonly used in acid-base and redox titrations.
map.N = n·z / V；z 为每摩尔的当量数。 1 mol H₂SO₄(z=2): N = n x z / V, where z is the equivalents per mole. 1 mol of H2SO4 (z=2) made up to 1 L gives 2 N.
map.酸碱滴定：一元酸 z=1、二元酸 z=2，N=c·z。: For acid-base titration: a monoprotic acid has z=1 and a diprotic acid z=2, so N = c x z.
map.氧化还原：由电子转移数定 z，算当量浓度。: For redox: z is set by the number of electrons transferred, then the equivalent concentration follows.
map.当量换算：N 与 c 经 z 桥接，统一计量。: Equivalent conversion: N and c are bridged through z, unifying the units.
map.：输入 c=0.1 mol/L、z=2，工具输出 N=0.2 N，并提示 z 随: Entering c=0.1 mol/L and z=2, the tool outputs N=0.2 N and notes that z changes with the reaction type.
map.道尔顿分压（Pᵢ = xᵢ · P_总）: Dalton Partial Pressure (P_i = x_i x P_total)
map.由酸解离常数与浓度估算 pH: Estimate pH from the acid dissociation constant and concentration
map.z（当量数）怎么定？: How is z (the equivalent factor) determined?
map.酸碱看可交换 H⁺/OH⁻ 数；氧化还原看电子转移数。: Acid-base looks at the number of exchangeable H+/OH-; redox looks at the number of electrons transferred.
map.当量浓度现在常用吗？: Is equivalent concentration still commonly used?
map.滴定仍用，尤其氧化还原；现代多直接用 mol/L+z。: Still used in titration, especially redox; modern practice mostly uses mol/L plus z directly.
map.N 和 c 能直接比吗？: Can N and c be compared directly?
map.N=z·c，z 不同数值不同，需注明反应类型。: N = z x c, and the values differ with z, so the reaction type must be stated.
